visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an extreme close-up of hands in plastic gloves shredding cooked chicken meat onto a bed of green cilantro; a thick, dark red chili sauce is poured over the meat. (2) A raw chicken leg is placed on a wooden cutting board, and a knife scores the skin; it is then moved to a metal bowl where white seasoning powder and clear liquid are added. (3) Green onions and ginger slices are added to the chicken in the bowl before it is placed in an electric steamer. (4) Dark red peppercorns are fried in oil within a black pan, then the oil is strained through a metal mesh into a glass bowl. (5) Minced garlic, chili flakes, and various sauces are sautéed in the pan, with fresh green scallions and cilantro mixed in to create a glossy, dark red sauce. (6) The steamed chicken is shredded by gloved hands into a glass container, then plated with the spicy sauce; a pair of wooden chopsticks lifts a glossy piece of seasoned chicken to the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a male speaker delivering a friendly, high-energy introduction over an upbeat, major-key electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 beat. (2) A sharp 'thud' of a knife hitting a wooden board is heard, followed by the clear 'splash' of liquid ingredients being poured into a metal bowl. (3) Continuous narration explains the marinating process while high-pitched sizzling sounds of peppercorns in oil emerge in the background. (4) Distinct metallic 'clinks' of a spoon stirring in a pan are balanced with the speaker's fast-paced, enthusiastic recipe instructions. (5) The audio concludes with the soft 'tearing' sound of chicken being shredded, ending on a positive vocal inflection as the chef encourages trying the dish.
